theme: Money set aside for failures not yet seen
title: Warranty Reserves From a Mix-Shifting Claims Triangle
strategies: naive as-reported: assume every cohort's already-reported claims are the whole story, reserve nothing further
textbook chain-ladder: pool ALL cohorts into one aggregate age-to-age development-factor curve (blind to product mix) and apply it to each cohort's own latest reported value

cohort/development separation: read per-type ultimate value rates directly off the fully-developed cohorts via a mix-weighted regression, then project every cohort (however immature) through its own known mix
own-cohort partial-development shrinkage blended with the mix-regression prior (headroom above the reference strong solution)
